summary: The official City of Modesto GIS and its current public ArcGIS parcel layer were verified from first-party pages and service metadata. Direct bounded parcel query attempts timed out or were inaccessible through the request route, so no sample geometry was retained. Runtime remains held pending serial review.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official City GIS page identifies the City GIS program and interactive map.
Official City of Modesto GIS viewer found; viewer disclaimer warns availability is not guaranteed.
Public ArcGIS Feature Layer Parcels (Offline), polygon geometry, supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF, source WKID 102643, fields include apn and OBJECTID.

requestOutcomes.method: GET bounded envelope query with ID-plus-geometry fields
requestOutcomes.outcome: Direct curl request timed out after 20 seconds; the equivalent first-party query URL was also inaccessible through the browsing route. No geometry or attributes were logged as successful response data.
MapServer layer route was not accessible through the browsing route; FeatureServer metadata remained the usable schema evidence.
Official page links to Download an Assessor's Platt Map and Explore Modesto GIS, confirming local parcel-map procedures but not an API response.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: Exact WUP point preserved in latitude/longitude order. The planned ArcGIS envelope was derived in source CRS WKID 2227 only for a bounded request; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.

geometryQuality: No geometry response was successfully obtained; no GeoJSON sample was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City-hosted County Parcels Offline service with a broad Stanislaus County extent in service metadata.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous first-party layer metadata and schema only; no bounded geometry response.
